To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Android’s architecture embodies the principles found in contemporary software architecture literature, and that the architecture of Android apps is largely aligned with Android’s architecture.

1) Android’s architecture is based on a set of principles, which we identify, that have been conceived by software architects in the decade prior to Android; 2) Android’s architecture, in turn, has influenced the architecture of its ecosystem of apps; and 3) we can trace these principles in Android’s architecture and its apps to their conception in software architectural research.
the architectural principles of today’s mobile software are rooted in the research of the past decade and are employed by the majority of Android apps.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role that architectural concepts play in today’s mobile software ecosystem and the extent to which those concepts are employed in practice.
how the architectural principles that were conceived in the context of software architecture research have found their way into the construction and deployment of mobile software.
the role that software architecture principles play in the conception and practice of contemporary mobile software.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the principles of contemporary mobile software architecture are rooted in the pioneering advances in the field of software architecture research.
Android is a software architecture.
Android is an excellent example of how software architecture principles can be successfully implemented in practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the principles of software architecture, which were conceived in research, have been adopted in contemporary mobile software.
the principles that have guided the design, construction, deployment, and evolution of contemporary mobile software have been inspired by software architectural research.
the architectural principles of contemporary mobile software have been conceived in the past decade, and that they are now widely adopted in practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
architectural principles are the foundation of today’s mobile software.
software architecture research, which was once considered a luxury, has now become a necessity in the design of contemporary mobile software.
the principles of software architecture are alive, well, and thriving in the mobile ecosystem, and that they are being applied in practice to solve real problems in mobile software.
